discription: A warm saw wave synth with a resonant low-pass filter, where the filter cutoff is modulated by an envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, cutoffMax=6000, filterAttack=0.01, filterDecay=0.2, filterSustain=0.5, filterRelease=0.5; var ampEnv = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); var filterEnv = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(filterAttack, filterDecay, filterSustain, filterRelease, curve: -4), gate: gate ); var filterFreq = LinLin.ar(filterEnv, 0, 1, freq * 1.5, cutoffMax); var sig = Saw.ar(freq); sig = LPF.ar(sig, filterFreq, rq:rq); Out.ar(out, sig * amp * ampEnv ! 2); }
